exposure: Timing of prenatal care initiation (prior to third trimester vs. third trimester or later)
finding: Women with depression who received late or no prenatal care prior to the third trimester had higher odds of adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes, including stillbirth, neonatal death, preterm delivery, small for gestational age, and severe preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Women with depression who received late or no prenatal care had higher odds of cesarean delivery compared to those who received prenatal care prior to the third trimester.
